{{Quote|Spast, Cannon&mdash;that scav ''had'' to be an ace pilot to dust all ''four'' of us!|Tev Rimon to Brodie Coburn, after Cade Skywalker outflew Skull Squadron|<ref name="Legacy 14" />}}
'''Tev Rimon''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the service of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|New Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. He flew a [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighter]], under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of "'''Crasher'''" in [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gunn Yage]]'s [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]], a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What we have are ''orders'', Skulls. Don't have to ''like'' 'em. Just obey 'em.''"<br />"''I'm good. Let the Sith take care of their own. What do I care?|Gunn Yage and Tev Rimon|<ref name="Legacy 19">[[Legacy (2006) 19|''Legacy'' (2006) 19]]</ref>}}
Tev Rimon,<ref name="CSWE" /> also known by the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Crasher," was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Legacy 14" /> [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. He was commanded by [[Gunn Yage]] as part of [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]]<ref name="CSWE" /> during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] flew as part of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] ruled by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="Legacy 14" />

[[File:ImperialPilots.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tev Rimon with his fellow Skulls]]
Rimon and the other pilots were stationed on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]] attempted to rescue the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Hosk Trey'lis]] from the [[Temple of the Sith]]. Given orders to capture Skywalker alive, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Rimon and the Skulls engaged the former Jedi's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], in the skies of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] until Skywalker managed to lose his pursuers in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]]. Rimon returned to [[Skull Squadron Hangar]] with his squadmates.<ref name="Legacy 14" />

Rimon flew against the ''Mynock'' once again when a group of Skywalker's allies, including the former Jedi's mother, [[Morrigan Corde]], piloted the ship as they attempted to rescue Skywalker from the Sith Temple where he was being held captive. Just as the Skulls started to wear down the ''Mynock'', they were given orders to abort the mission by Captain Yage's father, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rulf Yage]], to avoid violating the Sith's airspace.<ref name="Legacy 19" /> Rimon later participated, along with the rest of the squadron, in the [[Operation: Thunderstroke]].<ref name="Legacy 44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>

A year later, [[138 ABY]], Rimon fought in the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]],<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref> where Skull Squadron was given orders to shoot down a Jedi shuttle. Captain Yage refused to shoot defenseless children and shot [[Darth Rauder]] instead.<ref name="Legacy War 4" /> Rimon complied with Yage's commands and joined the Empire-in-Exile to fight against the Sith on Coruscant.<ref name="Legacy War 5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref>
